scientific_integrity: The general proof is mathematical and invokes the classical Skolem existence theorem. Finite checker tests are illustrative only. No independence or external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Cyclic rational elliptic groups of order 6m only, m congruent to 0 or 1 mod 4; other orders/groups and uniqueness of covers not addressed. Historical priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Sharp line covers for cyclic even-order plane cubics via Skolem sequences
